purpose: Evidence-bound historical lineage, additional archive-recovered Garden candidates, and non-patent IP asset categories complementing IP_ORIGIN_INVENTORY.json.
interpretation_rules: Historical F/P identifiers are snapshot-scoped unless a stable mapping is independently established.
Portfolio headline counts are lineage snapshots and must never be added together as independent inventions.
SOURCE_DETAIL_NOT_RECOVERED is preferable to inventing a missing old family or subfamily label.
Garden-origin is a provenance classification, not automatic legal exclusivity.
Known science, standards, equations, generic algorithms, and third-party technology are prior basis, not Garden inventions merely because Garden uses them.
A concrete new technical combination may remain a Garden-origin candidate even when its ingredients are old.
No model review creates filing, grant, ownership, infringement, enforceability, certification, or legal-opinion status.

numbering_drift_evidence: On 2026-05-06, F14 appears as Multi-Agent in an earlier snapshot and as Single-Pass Chip Development in a later snapshot.
F16/F17/F18/F19 labels also moved between inference, governance, multi-agent, reasoning, media, robotics, and universal-substrate snapshots.
F110-F117 mappings were later repurposed/normalized as integration-constrained embodiments; snapshot provenance controls interpretation.
Therefore no bare F-number is treated as globally stable without its date/snapshot binding.
